verdict.rationale: Official docs confirm dedicated iOS and Android SDKs for Terminal, alongside JS/React Native, enabling developers to embed custom in-person payment flows including reader management, offline support, tipping, and testing simulators. Community evidence corroborates real-world use of the API-based integration for building custom POS apps on Stripe's stack. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of the iOS/Android SDK integration experience (most community evidence discusses the broader Terminal API/hardware rather than the mobile SDKs specifically).
